topic: Decide, for each idea in Google's Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.2), whether system-spec-kit should adopt, adapt or reject it.

promotedIdeas.idea: Structured provenance block on research/review artifacts + resolution rule
One-way packet to OKF bundle export command
Freshness marker on decay-prone artifacts only
Optional type key on core templates, no backfill
promotedIdeas.risk: low value until a consumer exists

suppressedIdeas.idea: verified trust tiers and attestation protocol
suppressedIdeas.reason: self-declared/advisory by spec; runtime protocol deferred; second truth vs closure gates

suppressedIdeas.idea: per-folder index.md and log.md file families
suppressedIdeas.reason: new drift class; fail-closed index walker conflict; duplicates Phase Documentation Map and changelogs

suppressedIdeas.idea: in-place OKF corpus conformance and bundle import
suppressedIdeas.reason: multi-thousand-doc migration class; import structurally blocked by generated sidecars

rejectedPatterns.pattern: treat description.json as an OKF concept
rejectedPatterns.reason: generated file, no body, no OKF mapping
generated sidecars have no OKF representation; every validator fires on imported docs

sources.repositoryClaimPolicy: file:line for every repository claim; URL for every web claim; live-run observations dated
